Hi Elena,

Thanks again for the sync earlier — excited about the Storify pilot. To size a Dedicated fleet that matches your traffic shape we need a short census of session and prompt characteristics. Below is a focused questionnaire (should take ~10–15 minutes). If you can paste answers or attach a small sample trace it’ll help us produce an initial SKU and burst plan.

1) Peak concurrent sessions (30-minute window) and typical sustained concurrency:
2) Percent of sessions that are short-lived (<10s) vs long-lived (>60s):
3) Avg and 95th percentile prompt length (tokens) and response length (tokens):
4) Fraction of requests that use tool/function calls or multimodal inputs (~%):
5) Typical P50/P95 tail-latency SLO targets (ms) and acceptable cost band:
6) Known seasonal peaks or daily parting (example times/days):
7) Any strict data residency/KMS/HSM requirements?
8) Sample telemetry attached if available (request id, timestamp, prompt_len, resp_len, latency_ms).

If it helps I can supply a quick template CSV for export. After you send this back we’ll run a micro-sizer to propose GPU mix, burst pool size, and per-token estimates.

Thanks — cc’ing Laura who will join sizing if we need to iterate on quantization/latency tradeoffs.

— Priyom

From: Elena Park <elena@storify.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@storify.ai
Date: 2028-11-06T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity intake — session-tiling & prompt-length census

Hi Priyom — thanks, filled this out inline below and attached a 24-hour sample export from our staging telemetry. Hope this helps.

1) Peak concurrent sessions (30-min window): 1,800; sustained (24h moving): ~720
2) Session length: ~68% short-lived (<10s), 22% mid (10–60s), 10% long-lived (>60s)
3) Prompt length: avg 24 tokens, p95 210; Response length: avg 42 tokens, p95 1,150
4) Tool/function calls: ~12% of requests; Multimodal: 3% (images + text)
5) Latency SLOs: P50 80ms, P95 350ms — procurement says they'd accept P95 up to 500ms for burst windows if cost-saving fallback applied
6) Daily peaks: 11:30–13:30 PST and 18:00–20:00 PST; weekly peaks Tue–Thu; known marketing spikes once/month (approx +60% for 6 hrs)
7) Data residency: US-only; KMS via customer-managed key preferred
8) Attached: storify_telemetry_sample.csv (columns: request_id,timestamp,prompt_len,resp_len,latency_ms,session_id)

Notes: We currently route short transactional prompts to a smaller, cheaper model and long-form chat to a larger one. For Dedicated we’re considering consolidating into a single variant if latency & cost align.

Thanks — Elena
Elena Park | Head of Platform Engineering, Storify.ai
elena@storify.ai | +1 (650) 555-0199
